ycy fs
Browse a directory in a browser
Usage:
  ycy fs [directory] [flags]
Flags:
  --account	Account in username:password form (repeatable)
  -a, --address	Address to bind
  --chunked-upload	Enable retryable large-file uploads
  -h, --help	help for fs
  -m, --manage	Enable filesystem management
  -p, --port	Port to serve on
  --safe-html	Serve HTML and XHTML originals as sandboxed downloads
  --session-dir	Directory for Go-owned login sessions
  --session-idle-days	Session idle lifetime in days
  --upload-chunk-size	Chunk size in MiB (4-16)
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
